Use case: ads-marketing. Generate a completely NEW original dry fashion Chinese ecommerce portrait page, canvas1034x1521, using only attached ORIGINAL references. Image1 sole fictional ADULT M001 woman's identity, image2 accurate silver round showerhead geometry, image3 actual small LOW FLAT white outlet eyelet geometry. Image4 R022 ONLY supplies composition, fashion pose, warm ivory background, oversized left typography and large left foreground handheld object. Do not copy image4 woman, square product, words, flags or logos.
Preserve this exact layout: warm pale-ivory seamless backdrop with soft gentle natural commercial light, white glossy tabletop at very bottom. Giant dark warm BROWN bold slightly slanted Chinese heading upper left in two lines exactly “下方” then “切档”, occupying top left third. Small BLACK support line upper right exactly “按键靠近手柄”. Nothing else written. Bottom/right two thirds: M001 with long loose dry black hair, same hazel eyes/oval face/nose/lips as image1, looking calmly toward viewer, wearing opaque ivory sleeveless elegant blouse, seated behind table. Her RIGHT elbow rests on table and RIGHT hand supports cheek/chin naturally; her LEFT hand naturally grips silver showerhead handle in LEFT foreground. Normal anatomy, plausible five fingers. Full shower head front faces viewer at left, very large to balance her face at right, round head should be about size of her foreground face. It is a beauty fashion portrait with resting-cheek pose and asymmetry, not a robe/white-coat standing testimonial or certificate page.
Actual product must match image2/3: round bright SILVER head casing and handle, continuous black face, many evenly small flat near-flush WHITE eyelets, tiny peripheral black perforations, central RED descaling ring/button, separate SILVER selector just below face. No protruding white nozzle cylinders, large donuts, rings engraved in panel, dark product housing or square shower. Dry page absolutely NO WATER. Handle extends near bottom edge/table, if threaded inlet visible it is SILVER, no dark thread or connector. No hose/bracket/accessories. Skin fresh with soft continuous natural tones, subtle RANDOM variation only; clean gentle commercial beauty look. Absolutely no repeating diagonal grid, fishscale, crosshatch, woven/etched/tiled/embossed skin; no crispy hyperdetail. Preserve crisp hair/eyes/lips and soft smooth believable face, neck and arms. Do not reuse ANY old generated portrait. No text beyond specified heading/support, no brand, flag, badge, certificates, modes labels, claims, numbers or added props. Maintain R022 composition/colour/light/type hierarchy/information density.
